header: An intro that stays while the list scrolls past
lead: One column is pinned, the other carries a dozen entries. Use it where a capability page is dense enough that the reader would otherwise lose what the list is a list of.

items.title: Sticky above the medium breakpoint
items.text: Below it the columns stack and the pinning is dropped entirely.

items.title: Clear of the site header
items.text: The offset is the header height plus a gutter, so the first line is never hidden.

items.title: Reverse moves the intro
items.text: The column order changes; the source order does not.

items.title: Three to twelve entries
items.text: Fewer than three and the pinning has nothing to sit still for.

items.title: Entries can link out
items.text: The whole row becomes the target, as everywhere else in the group.
